name: Asagiri Nono
source:
Born in Shimizu, Tokachi and raised in Sapporo. Her parents are often away on business trips abroad, so she currently lives with her grandmother at their house. She's a 2nd year high school student. She's quite clumsy, so when she picks up a kitchen knife to cook, her grandmother stops her with a pale face. The use of firearms is also prohibitied. Recently, the use of microwaves has been allowed.

Honest, cheerful, and enegertic. Sadly, her heart and mind stopped growing in elementary school. She is sociable and is liked by both animals and people. She often talks to animals in public, so she is seen as a bit strange. She hides a flying squirrel somewhere.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
